# Raw family data (generated by `python3 make_data.py`)

`b` is the B-endpoint produced by `Computation.bz82.pi_forward`, `lam` the
D-image `Tinv(b)`, `steps` the number of alternating applications.
Columns are defined by the printed rules only; see PROOF_families.md.
